Committee: Constitution, Campaigns and Elections
Sponsor: Clarke
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 04/20/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 180 as introduced would increase the obligations of the State General Fund for election expenses by (1) an estimated $514,000 for poll worker compensation for each election where in-person early voting is authorized; and (2) an undetermined amount for costs of publicizing information regarding the early voting centers.
Bob Fincher, Chair
Constitution, Campaigns and Elections
